SEEQC reports it is working with NVIDIA on a chip-to-chip link between quantum computers and GPUs.

SEEQC, the digital quantum computing company, announced today that it is working toward the first all-digital, ultra-low-latency chip-to-chip link between quantum computers and GPUs, compatible with any quantum computing system, in collaboration with NVIDIA.

John Levy, CEO and co-founder of SEEQC, told The Quantum Insider: "We've been exploring this collaboration for the previous year, and during that time we've had an opportunity to work closely with the quantum team at NVIDIA to ensure that we will meet both market and technical requirements to make this a success.
